rt:param.name: Data_Type
rt:param.comment: Тип переменной или номер бита в NARY

rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub Calculate() Dim Al_Date As String Dim Al_Time As String Dim Al_ID As String Dim Al_PVName As String Dim Al_Descr As String Dim Al_Description As String Dim Date_Time As String Dim Al_Level As Byte Dim BoundIndex As Short Dim BoundType As UInt Dim PSN0 As Short
If Data_Type == 1 Then //бинарная переменная A_BIN_pv = BIN(PV_Nr) Date_Time = CStr(A_BIN_pv.FirstNotAckedAlarmTime) Al_Date = PRJSPEC.ComSplit(Date_Time, Al_Time) If AlarmShowRTM Then Al_ID = A_BIN_pv.CategoryText Else Al_ID = A_BIN_pv.PVId End If Al_PVName = A_BIN_pv.PVId If A_BIN_pv.NotAcknowledged Then If A_BIN_pv.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then Is_NotAcked = 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Al_Level = 8 //8 - неактивные Else Is_NotAcked = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация Al_Level = A_BIN_pv.AlarmLevel End If Else Is_NotAcked = 0 Al_Level = A_BIN_pv.AlarmLevel End If 'для BIN переменных надо брать уровень из PRJSPECNR0 PSN0 = (A_BIN_pv.ProjSpecNr0 & 0xF0) / 16 If ((PSN0 & 7) == 0) || (Al_Level == 8) Then BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_NONE BoundIndex = -1 Else BoundIndex = (PSN0 & 7) - 1 If ((PSN0 & 8) == 1) Then BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_LO Else BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI End If End If Al_Descr = PLStrCut(A_BIN_pv.PVDescription, 50) Al_Description = A_BIN_pv.PVDescription
ElseIf Data_Type == 2 Then //аналоговая переменная A_ANA_pv = ANA(PV_Nr) Date_Time = CStr(A_ANA_pv.FirstNotAckedAlarmTime) Al_Date = PRJSPEC.ComSplit(Date_Time, Al_Time) If AlarmShowRTM Then Al_ID = A_ANA_pv.CategoryText Else Al_ID = A_ANA_pv.PVId End If Al_PVName = A_ANA_pv.PVId If A_ANA_pv.NotAcknowledged Then If A_ANA_pv.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then Is_NotAcked = 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Al_Level = 8 //8 - неактивные Else Is_NotAcked = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация Al_Level = A_ANA_pv.AlarmLevel End If Else Is_NotAcked = 0 Al_Level = A_ANA_pv.AlarmLevel End If BoundType = A_ANA_pv.BoundViolType BoundIndex = A_ANA_pv.BoundViolIndex Al_Descr = PLStrCut(A_ANA_pv.PVDescription, 50) Al_Description = A_ANA_pv.PVDescription
ElseIf (Data_Type >=10) && (Data_Type <= 25) Then //многобитовая переменная A_BIN_pv = BIN(PV_Nr) Date_Time = CStr(A_BIN_pv.FirstNotAckedAlarmTime) Al_Date = PRJSPEC.ComSplit(Date_Time, Al_Time) If AlarmShowRTM Then Al_ID = A_BIN_pv.CategoryText Else Al_ID = A_BIN_pv.PVId End If
If (((2 ** (Data_Type - 10)) & A_BIN_pv.NaryAlarmOn) > 0) Then Is_NotAcked = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация Al_Level = A_BIN_pv.AlarmLevel Else Is_NotAcked = 0 Al_Level = 8 //8 - неактивные End If 'для BIN переменных надо брать уровень из PRJSPECNR0 PSN0 = (A_BIN_pv.ProjSpecNr0 & 0xF0) / 16 If ((PSN0 & 7) == 0) Then BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_NONE BoundIndex = -1 Else BoundIndex = (PSN0 & 7) - 1 If ((PSN0 & 8) == 1) Then BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_LO Else BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI End If End If Al_Description = PRJSPEC.Get_BST_Descr(A_BIN_pv.PVId, (Data_Type - 10)) Al_Descr = PLStrCut(Al_Description, 50)
ElseIf (PV_Nr == -1) Then //нет сигнализации Al_Date = "" Al_Time = "" Al_ID = "" Al_PVName = "" Al_Level = -1 BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_NONE BoundIndex = -1 Is_NotAcked = 0 Al_Descr = "" Al_Description = "Сигнализации нет" Else //неизвестный тип переменной Al_Date = "???" Al_Time = "???" Al_ID = "???" Al_PVName = "" Al_Level = -1 BoundType = PLS_BOUNDVIOL_NONE BoundIndex = -1 Is_NotAcked = 0 Al_Descr = "Неизвестный тип сигнала" Al_Description = "Неизвестный тип сигнала" End If T_Date.text = Al_Date T_Time.text = Al_Time T_ID.text = Al_ID T_ID.title = Al_PVName T_Descr.text = Al_Descr T_Descr.title = Al_Description If (Al_Level >= 0) && (Al_Level < 9) Then If (AnaAlarms_AsBounds) && (Data_Type == 2 ) Then If (A_ANA_pv.BoundViolType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI) Then If (BoundIndex >= 2) Then Txt_Color = Color_ANA_HI_A ElseIf (BoundIndex == 1) Then Txt_Color = Color_ANA_HI_P ElseIf (BoundIndex == 0) Then Txt_Color = Color_ANA_HI_T End If ElseIf (A_ANA_pv.BoundViolType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_LO) Then If (BoundIndex >= 2) Then Txt_Color = Color_ANA_LO_A ElseIf (BoundIndex == 1) Then Txt_Color = Color_ANA_LO_P ElseIf (BoundIndex == 0) Then Txt_Color = Color_ANA_LO_T End If Else Txt_Color = ColorAlarm(Al_Level) End If Else Txt_Color = ColorAlarm(Al_Level) End If Else Txt_Color = 0 End If T_Date.fill = Txt_Color T_Time.fill = Txt_Color T_ID.fill = Txt_Color T_Descr.fill = Txt_Color
Border_Circle.visibility = "hidden" Border_Up.visibility = "hidden" Border_Dn.visibility = "hidden"
If (BoundType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_HI) Then Border_Up.visibility = "visible" If (Al_Level == 8) Then Border_Up.fill = Color_ANA_GOOD ElseIf (BoundIndex >= 2) Then Border_Up.fill = Color_ANA_HI_A ElseIf (BoundIndex == 1) Then Border_Up.fill = Color_ANA_HI_P ElseIf (BoundIndex == 0) Then Border_Up.fill = Color_ANA_HI_T Else Border_Up.fill = ColorAlarm(Al_Level) End If ElseIf (BoundType == PLS_BOUNDVIOL_LO) Then Border_Dn.visibility = "visible" If (Al_Level == 8) Then Border_Dn.fill = Color_ANA_GOOD ElseIf (BoundIndex >= 2) Then Border_Dn.fill = Color_ANA_LO_A ElseIf (BoundIndex == 1) Then Border_Dn.fill = Color_ANA_LO_P ElseIf (BoundIndex == 0) Then Border_Dn.fill = Color_ANA_LO_T Else Border_Dn.fill = ColorAlarm(Al_Level) End If /* Решили показывать только верхние или нижние нарушения. Без нарушений гр. - ничего не показывать. ElseIf (BoundIndex != -1) Then Border_Circle.visibility = "visible" If (Al_Level == 8) Then Border_Circle.fill = Color_ANA_GOOD ElseIf (BoundIndex >= 2) Then Border_Circle.fill = Color_ANA_LO_A ElseIf (BoundIndex == 1) Then Border_Circle.fill = Color_ANA_LO_P ElseIf (BoundIndex == 0) Then Border_Circle.fill = Color_ANA_LO_T Else Border_Circle.fill = ColorAlarm(Al_Level) End If */ End If End Sub
